messages:
sara_eng: FYI I'm booking a schema change for tenant_preferences (add JSONB col + ghost index + backfill) in tomorrow's 02:30 UTC change window. Deploybot will perform the operations; please add a soft-quarantine and an automated rollback gate.

deploybot: Job scheduled for 2024-12-22 02:30:00 UTC (id=dbmig-1716609). Holdpoints configured: build-ghost, soft-quarantine-canary(10%), pause-replica-apply, post-backfill-sample-validate. Notifying: @leo_db @mike_sre @danielle_pm.

leo_db: SQL is straightforward but backfill can blow out replica apply lag. Proposed plan: create index concurrently as a ghost, run chunked backfill throttled to 150 rows/s, chunk_size 500. Abort if replica lag > 45s for 2 continuous minutes.

mike_sre: Agreed. We should pause replica replay during the final ALTER INDEX ... ATTACH to prevent a replication surge. How will we coordinate pause/unpause?

leo_db: Deploybot supports hooks; I added a small orchestration script: ```bash
# pause replica replay (uses replica-manager)
replica-manager pause --cluster=prod --reason="migration-tenantprefs" --until=02:45
```

sara_eng: Also toggle the service schema pin to v2-tenantprefs for the window so older code paths can be used if we roll back. Danielle - is that acceptable from product?

danielle_pm: Yes, product confirms the fallback path is enabled. We'll flip feature flag to preserve behavior if needed. Rollback via flag -> zero user impact.

olivia_oncall: Add an automated rollback condition: if post-validation mismatches exceed 0.05% or if HTTP 5xx rate > 2x baseline for a sustained 4m window, stop rollout, revert schema metadata, and page oncall.

deploybot: Rollback rule set: metric=http_5xx_4m trigger=>2x baseline sustained 4m; validation=sample-check returns mismatches>0.05%; action=halt rollout, run revert-metadata job, create incident tag=migration-db, page oncall.

leo_db: Post-step validation script (runs after 10m soft-quarantine): ```python
# sample_validate.py
# samples 2000 tenant ids, compares previous retrieval vs new index path
# exits nonzero if mismatches > 0.05%
```

mike_sre: Can we make the soft-quarantine more explicit: after ghost build and partial backfill, route 10% of traffic to the new path for 12 minutes, run validation, then either finalize or rollback. If rollback, keep the ghost index unattached and let it be cleaned up.

sara_eng: Sequence agreed: 1) preflight checks + replica pause 2) create ghost index concurrently 3) chunked backfill (150r/s) 4) soft-quarantine: 10% traffic for 12m with validation 5) finalize attach or trigger rollback.

leo_db: Added rate limiter config for Deploybot: ```json
{"backfill_rate":150, "chunk_size":500, "max_parallel_chunks":6}
```

danielle_pm: I'll add a short release note: "Improved tenant preferences lookup via new index. Small maintenance window; read replicas may lag briefly." Keep copy minimal and customer-friendly.

olivia_oncall: Paging policy: if automatic rollback fires, page primary oncall (sms+phone) and open incident with severity=P1 tag migration-db.

mike_sre: Watch out for lock escalation on final attach. Set finalization timeout to 240s: if attach takes longer, abort and leave index in ghost state. Implement cleanup to avoid table bloat.

leo_db: Finalization guard added to Deploybot: abort if attach_duration > 240s. Cleanup path will run a VACUUM and schedule the orphan ghost index for GC.

sara_eng: Runbook snippet please (short commands we can use during window).

leo_db: Runbook rollback commands: ```bash
# stop rollout
deploybot stop dbmig-1716609
# reset schema metadata pin
db-meta set-schema-version prod v1
# remove partially migrated rows (if needed)
psql -c "DELETE FROM tenant_preferences_new WHERE migrated=true AND migrated_at > '2024-12-22'" 
```

mike_sre: And to resume replicas after success/abort: ```bash
replica-manager resume --cluster=prod
```

deploybot: Preflight checks OK at 2024-12-21T22:40:00Z. Holdpoints and rollback thresholds configured. Will post updates in-thread during execution.

sara_eng: Thanks team. I'll be on the channel during the window. Ping @sara_eng for any decision calls. :rocket:

olivia_oncall: Oncall coverage confirmed: olivia (primary), mike_sre (backup).

danielle_pm: Noting changelog entry. Good luck everyone.

deploybot: Final state: scheduled -> 02:30 UTC. Progress messages will land here when execution begins. Good luck. :white_check_mark:
